name: Tsukushite Ai DOLL! ~Master Daisuki~
original_name: 尽くして愛DOLL！～マスター大好きっ～
source:
Main character goes to throw away trash and finds a broken "doll" in the dump. He manages to fix it at home and even registers as her master. It turns out to be love doll who eagerly provides sex services to beloved master on daily basis.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公外出倒垃圾时，在垃圾场发现了一个损坏的“人偶”。他设法在家中将其修好，甚至登记成为她的主人。原来这是一个性爱人偶，每天都会热情地为深爱的主人提供性服务。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
